nodes.label: Repository Cleanup & Presentability Plan (v5)
nodes.rationale: The repo is internally rigorous and externally underdeveloped: a visitor sees no demo, screenshot, or CI badges, so the project's real maturity is obscured. Seven phases sequenced by visible-impact-per-cost; keeping diagnosis adjacent to prescription is why it is one plan rather than seven.

nodes.label: Working-tree hygiene sweep
nodes.rationale: 16 untracked files persisted across a multi-day session — a 9.5 MB corrupt lightningcss .bak, 9 abandoned dev screenshots, and three completed plan files that should have been archived. .gitignore grows /share-*.png and /.tmp-*/ so the same classes cannot re-accumulate.

nodes.label: Presentation polish (README, metadata, governance)
nodes.rationale: package.json keeps private:true and version 0.0.0 (correct for an unpublished GitHub-Pages app — prevents accidental npm publish) but gains license/description/homepage/repository/keywords. Adds CODE_OF_CONDUCT, issue/PR templates, CodeQL workflow, and a freshly generated hero screenshot; OSSF Scorecard was declined by the user.

nodes.label: Test-fixture consolidation
nodes.rationale: Surfaced by the five /simplify passes during the GameController extraction: Window.__funworldmap_game re-cast inline at 3 production sites with no shared declare global, __testAnalytics redeclared at 5 sites, makeCountryReveal/makePointReveal/makeOutcome byte-identical across two hook test files, and three separate implementations of makeFakeMap.

nodes.label: modePredicates — stringly-typed mode-ID comparisons
nodes.rationale: 36 stringly-typed mode-ID comparisons (re-verified firsthand; previous estimate 23), worst offender useHashGameRouter.ts with 5+ sites. ModeId is a string union so TypeScript catches typos, but the literal-string sites pile up — at this count the user promoted predicate helpers from optional to REQUIRED.

nodes.label: Reveal-color semantic constants
nodes.rationale: 10 inline hex codes in useRevealMapEffects plus 3 more in its test encode three semantic colors (#22c55e correct, #f59e0b warn, #ef4444 far) with no named constants; mapPalette.ts exists but carries only the TEAL/CORAL brand family, so reveal feedback has no home.

nodes.label: Nine ref-mirrors across the five extracted hooks
nodes.rationale: statusRef, pendingStartRef, lastRevealEmitHashRef, lastAttemptCountRef, prevStatusForTelemetryRef, recordedRef, lastAnnouncedRoundKeyRef, lastIntermediateAttemptCountRef, prevStatusForIntermediateRef — documented out-of-scope in the GameController extraction plan; replacement via useSyncExternalStore is a separate architectural refactor. eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1's stricter ref validation may surface new findings against them.

nodes.label: Tooling tier-up (typecheck script, husky, editorconfig, type-checked ESLint)
nodes.rationale: Type-checking only happened implicitly via tsc -b inside build; no pre-commit hooks meant avoidable CI noise from formatting/lint failures; no .editorconfig left indent/EOL to IDE plugins. The ESLint recommended-type-checked ruleset was deferred earlier because it surfaces many findings that must be fixed first.

nodes.label: Dependency hygiene phase
nodes.rationale: Substantial major-version lag (jsdom 4 majors, eslint-plugin-react-hooks 2, typescript/eslint 1 each) reframed as a maintainability cost rather than a CVE risk. Sequenced after Phase 4 so the ESLint 10 bump and the type-checked ruleset land together. @vitejs/plugin-react and Vite bumps explicitly deferred: plugin-react v5+ requires Vite 8+ and the repo is on Vite 6.4.2, so 4.7.0 is the newest compatible. Dependabot config added so the lag cannot silently re-accumulate.

nodes.label: Quarantined e2e tests triage
nodes.rationale: 5 tests across 3 issues: animation-interrupt x3 (#47, animation state unobservable under CI reduced-motion baseline), game-over-mode-switch (#32, timeout-dependent mode switch), launcher (#31, compositor frame production / ANGLE renderer flake). All honest test.fixme quarantines with issue links; the underlying causes remain unresolved and the phase may be blocked on GPU-runner availability.
